scope: Read-only static code and synthetic-evidence review; no scanner execution or actual delivery/raw/stage inputs read.

findings.description: Raw workspace-relative path, archive_path, member and manifest labels are copied into the receipt. A credential-shaped string in a file name or ZIP member name is consequently reproduced despite the candidate value field being [REDACTED]. Controls and inventory records also repeat such labels. This is a static counterexample, not a claim that actual files contain credentials.
findings.minimal_correction: Centralize report-facing locator sanitization; preserve an opaque digest/ordinal for correlation. Apply it to all origin/inventory/control/archive metadata labels. Add synthetic token-shaped file-name and ZIP-member-name tests asserting the token never appears in the full serialized receipt.

checks.reason: Candidate payloads use fixed [REDACTED]; normal errors contain fixed BoundaryError codes or exception type, not input parser messages. Metadata exception is recorded above.
Current remaining/completion/continuation archive builders write archive, archive_sha256, files containing path/bytes/sha256. Scanner uses these exact fields and resolves container beside manifest.

Checks bounded manifest entries, safe relative members, exact ZIP membership and count, duplicates, symlinks/encryption, declared size, container SHA and every member SHA before payload scan; rechecks text member bytes and container after scan. No extraction.

Positive strict integer limits, per-text/control/container/uncompressed/I/O/entry/candidate bounds. Exceedance is pending/nonzero, not silently clean. Repeated ZIP reads count toward I/O; root may need reviewed explicit overrides for large deliveries.

Unresolved pattern candidates cause review_required and exit2; pending without candidates exit3. Only narrow placeholder syntax or clearly constrained authorization prose receives an automatic disposition. A combined pending+candidate result remains nonzero and retains pending list.

Explicit file/list/manifest scope, metadata controls scanned, binary/unknown non-UTF8 exclusions recorded, no recursive predecessor scan/Git-index/whole-repository claim. File byte hashes must be checked against staged bytes separately; scanner output is explicitly not self-scanned.
